'''Stephen Morgan''' (also published as '''Steven Morgan''') played the [[2019 Endor Grand Prix]].<ref name="pc-rem">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2019-endor-grand-prix/ 2019 Endor Grand Prix], starwarsccg.org</ref> As Steven Morgan he finished 2nd at [[August 2001 Buford tournament]] on 4 August 2001 with [[Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|SYCFA non-flip racing]], according to Zafar Tejani's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2814">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-09-z-goes-to-gq-buford-aug-4th-2001d2814/ z-goes-to-gq-buford-aug-4th-2001], DeckTech (Zafar "Zmanthe1st" Tejani, 9 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-09-z-goes-to-gq-buford-aug-4th-2001d2814/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

== Card credits ==
The printed credit lines of 2 [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards|Virtual card]]s name Stephen Morgan (2 original concept credits).<ref name="labels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images. Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The credited cards are in [[Virtual Block 8]] and [[Virtual Set 4]], sets dated 2012–2016 on this wiki. The concept credit also names the event or award the concept came from: 2012 Georgia League (1 card). The full list of everyone credited is at [[Card Credits#Stephen Morgan|Card Credits]].
